\"changelog\",\n326\t    ];\n327\t    let investigate_signals = [\n328\t        \"investigate\",\n329\t        \"explore\",\n330\t        \"understand\",\n331\t        \"why does\",\n332\t        \"what causes\",\n333\t        \"how does\",\n334\t    ];\n335\t\n336\t    let mut scores: [usize; 6] = [0; 6]; // debug, feature, refactor, config, docs, investigate\n337\t\n338\t    for s in }\n352\t    }\n353\t    for s in &config_signals {\n354\t        if lower_slice.contains(s) {\n355\t            scores[3] += 1;\n356\t        }\n357\t    }\n358\t    for s in &docs_signals {\n359\t        if lower_slice.contains(s) {\n360\t            scores[4] += 1;\n361\t        }\n362\t    }\n363\t    for s in &investigate_signals {\n364\t        if lower_slice.contains(s) {\n365\t \"documentation\",\n380\t        \"investigation\",\n381\t    ];\n382\t    let max_idx = scores\n383\t        .iter()\n384\t        .enumerate()\n385\t        .max_by_key(|(_, &s)| s)\n386\t        .map(|(i, _)| i)\n387\t        .unwrap_or(0);\n388\t\n389\t    if scores[max_idx] == 0 {\n390\t        \"investigation\"\n391\t    } else {\n392\t        types[max_idx]\n393\t    }\n394\t}\n395\t\n396\t/// Load anti-pattern content from a session's sidecar file.\n397\t///\n398\t/// Returns formatted content with \"anti-pattern:\" prefixes for each pattern.\n399\tfn
